Method of Attack: Malvertising campaign using Google Ads to push fake KeePass download sites
Use of Punycode homograph attack to mimic legitimate KeePass domain
Distribution of digitally-signed MSI installer embedding a PowerShell script
PowerShell script downloads and decrypts GPG-encrypted RAR archive
Execution of malware loader 'FakeBat' which downloads and installs malware
Attack Vector: Malicious Google Ads leading to fake KeePass download sites
Punycode homograph domain URLs (e.g., xn--eepass-vbb.info, keeqass.info)
User clicking on malicious ads and downloading fake installer
Indicators of Compromise: PowerShell script associated with FakeBat malware loader
File named 'mergecap.exe' launched from decrypted archive
